runtime.connectingBody: The Tenshu tab hosting Mia is busy. Mia will load as soon as it answers.
runtime.elsewhereTitle: Tenshu is open in another tab
runtime.elsewhereBody: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your data can't get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
runtime.moving: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This part of Mia hit an unexpected error. Your data is safe — nothing was changed.

chat.greetingBody: Ask me about your calendar, workouts, places, files or devices — for example “what’s on my calendar tomorrow” or “workouts last week”.
chat.remaining: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
chat.lookOnly: In the browser Mia only looks things up: it can’t switch devices, run routines or add events.

history.memoryNote: Your conversation is kept only in this browser’s memory while Tenshu is open. It is never saved, and it is cleared when you sign out or Tenshu locks — the same as in the Mia app.

grants.title: What Mia can read
grants.body: Mia only reads what you allow, one app at a time. Turning something off here means Mia stops using it — it can’t answer from it, and it will say so rather than pretending there is nothing there.
grants.everywhere: These switches apply to Mia on all your devices.

errors.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_invalid_caller: This app is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_unannounced_session: Tenshu needs to reconnect. Please try again.
errors.error_unsupported_operation: This version does not support that yet.
errors.error_mia_utterance_too_long: That question is too long. Keep it under 500 characters.
errors.error_mia_invalid_zone: Mia couldn’t tell which time zone you’re in, so it didn’t ask. Check your browser’s time zone and try again.
errors.error_mia_bad_cursor: Couldn’t load earlier messages. Try again.
errors.error_mia_bad_page_size: Couldn’t load earlier messages. Try again.
errors.error_mia_conversation_not_found: This conversation is gone — it was cleared when you signed out or Tenshu locked.
errors.error_mia_session_cleared: You were signed out or Tenshu locked while Mia was answering, so that question wasn’t kept. Ask again.
errors.error_mia_unexpected_action: Mia wanted to change something, which it can’t do in the browser. Nothing was changed.
errors.error_mia_unknown_source: Mia doesn’t know that source. Nothing was changed.
errors.error_mia_no_write_grant: Mia can’t write to that source. Nothing was changed.
errors.bridge: Couldn’t reach Tenshu. Make sure it is open and unlocked, then try again.
errors.bridge_timeout: Tenshu took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bridge_not_permitted: Mia is not allowed to do that.

stream.stopped: Updates stopped — what you see may be out of date.
